about_the_game:
Planet Extincter is a 2D top-down strategy and action game that puts you in control of a single character exploring countless planets, each with unique biomes and resources to discover. Set up bases, manage your resources wisely, and fend off relentless waves of evolving alien creatures. Buckle up—your strategic decisions will be tested at every turn!

Key Features

  • Dynamic Planets & Biomes
    Explore procedurally generated planets, each belonging to a distinct biome such as Jungle, Desert, Frost, Molten, and Gem. Every planet harbors its own challenges, creatures, and resources, ensuring a fresh experience every time.

  • Real-Time Strategy Meets Action
    Construct facilities, manage your resources, and assemble defensive structures—all while controlling your character in fast-paced top-down combat. Waves of enemies only get tougher, forcing you to constantly adapt and refine your strategy.

  • Deep Resource Management
    Gather Iron, Copper, Uranium, and other materials to power up your base and upgrade your spaceship. Convert Liquid and Sun into energy, produce refined fuels, and craft specialized weapons. Balance short-term survival with long-term growth to stay ahead of your foes.

  • Extensive Research Tree
    Use the resources and BioShards you collect to unlock new tech in an expansive Research Tree. Upgrade your character’s armor, build advanced turrets, enhance your spaceship’s capabilities, and unlock powerful weapon variations.

  • Base Building & Defense
    Construct a wide array of buildings—from energy converters like Coal Burners and Dams to defensive turrets and cunning traps. Carefully design your defensive walls, organize your resource production, and unleash hell on any encroaching enemies.

  • Limitless Replayability
    Thanks to procedural generation, no two planets or play sessions are ever the same. Adapt to unexpected threats, discover new Challenge Zones, and experiment with different strategic approaches each time you land on a planet.

  • Ever-Evolving Enemies
    Face unique enemies in every biome, ranging from fast melee swarms to powerful ranged attackers. With each new planet you tackle (increasing your level progression), these creatures gain levels—and even variants—making them deadlier than ever.

  • Your Spaceship: A Mobile Fortress
    Land on a planet to establish a base, then upgrade your spaceship’s core, armor, thrusters, and more to unlock travel to higher-tier solar systems. Your ship doubles as a defensive stronghold—if it’s destroyed, you’ll have to regroup and try again!

How To Play

  • Touch Down on a New Planet
    Arrive via your spaceship onto a procedurally generated map. Choose your landing site wisely to maximize resource proximity and defensive positioning.

  • Explore & Gather Resources
    Venture into the fog of war to find essential materials like iron, copper, crude oil, and more. Keep an eye out for hostile patrols and special Challenge Zones for extra rewards.

  • Build & Defend Your Base
    Construct energy-producing structures, resource processors, turret defenses, and traps. As enemy waves grow in size and strength, refine your defenses and maintain a careful balance of resources.

  • Develop & Progress
    Upgrade your character, spaceship, and base via the Research Tree. Unlock new weapons, armor, and tactical upgrades to increase both offensive power and defensive resilience.

  • Take the Fight to Enemy Bases
    Tired of simply defending? Launch counterattacks on alien outposts. But beware—attacking one base may provoke retaliation from others.

  • Extract & Move On
    Once you’ve destroyed all alien strongholds—or gathered enough fuel for your spaceship—you can choose to leave the planet. Bring back crucial resources to your home base or push onward to new worlds.

Why Planet Extincter?

  • Combines real-time strategy, top-down action, and survival gameplay in a single, high-stakes package.

  • Diverse, procedurally generated planets provide endless exploration and challenge.

  • Extensive customization through the Research Tree—tailor your playstyle and gear to match your strategic preferences.

  • Keeps you continuously engaged with rising difficulty, varied enemy classes, and dynamic attack waves.

  • Perfect for fans of both action and strategy, offering depth, replayability, and high-tempo combat.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 1600 / Intel Core i5-8400
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX-Vega 64 / GeForce GTX 1080
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 3600 / Intel Core i7 7700K
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT (8 GB), AMD Radeon RX 6600 XT (8 GB), NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 SUPER (8 GB), NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 (8 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
